message: No detected input validation: The code loads datasets and normalizes pixel values with MinMaxScaler but performs no explicit schema checks, dtype assertions, shape guards, or value-range validations on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from local file paths with no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision for any remote or downloaded source.
No detected label flipping detection: The code does not validate label values against an expected set, compare label distributions, or use any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the training samples during data preparation.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights using torch.load() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading the state dict.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or neural-cleanse-style defenses are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The training code uses standard PyTorch Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train_test_split is used to create a held-out test set, the test data is not isolated before training (images/labels are passed together and split inside the training function), there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (AUC + accuracy) is used without indepen
No detected input sanitization: Images are loaded and MinMax-scaled but there are no shape checks, range validation, or rejection of malformed inputs before inference.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly (e.g., torch.round) without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based image classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
